title: Paul Tudor Jones: Lessons From a Life in the Markets

excerpts.label: Long JPY: undervalued 24 months with a live catalyst
excerpts.insight: PTJ identifies dollar/yen as highest-conviction current trade — yen grossly undervalued, $4.5T unhedged USD liability, new Japanese PM triggers Thatcher-style repatriation
excerpts.pm_takeaway: SHORT USDJPY NOW. Yen undervalued 24mo, $4.5T unhedged USD coil. New Japan PM = Thatcher catalyst. Every 'nation-first' reformer (Trump, Thatcher) saw domestic currency +10% instantly. Setup is live.

excerpts.label: 252% stock/GDP — historic equity overextension
excerpts.insight: US stock market cap at 252% of GDP vs 65% in 1929, 170% at 2000 peak. Mean-reversion to normalized PE = 30-35% equity decline = 80-90% GDP wealth destruction event
excerpts.pm_takeaway: RAISE CASH. At 252% mkt cap/GDP, a PE mean-reversion wipes 80-90% of GDP. Capital gains taxes go to zero, deficit explodes, bonds sell. Not a question of if — question of when. This is the most overstretched equity market in history.

excerpts.label: IPO unlock cascade — the 2000 analog
excerpts.insight: Buybacks retired 2-3% of market cap annually for a decade; hyperscalers now redirecting to capex. IPOs = 5-6% of market cap contemplated next 12 months. Unlock cascade = rolling equity top, identical to 1999-2000
excerpts.pm_takeaway: UNDERWEIGHT TECH. Primary buyer (buybacks) being removed as hyperscalers commit capex. 5-6% of mkt cap in IPOs + lockup unlocks = exact 2000 supply cascade. Watch unlock schedules — they are the timing trigger for the top.

excerpts.label: Bitcoin over gold as inflation hedge — and its tail risks
excerpts.insight: PTJ: Bitcoin is the best inflation hedge because finite supply beats gold's 2% annual growth. But two explicit tail risks: cyber warfare and quantum computing
excerpts.pm_takeaway: LONG BTC (peacetime). Superior scarcity over gold — finite vs +2% annual supply. But size against tail risks: kinetic conflict = cyber warfare kills electronic assets; quantum computing = cryptographic breach. Not a max-size conviction — a sized-for-tails conviction.

excerpts.label: AI safety: model insiders expect casualties before regulation
excerpts.insight: PTJ at a private AI safety conference: consensus among model-company scientists is that meaningful regulation only happens after 50-100M people die in an accident
excerpts.pm_takeaway: HEDGE AI TAIL RISK. Fat-tail, unpriced. No regulatory framework, model insiders admit they wait for mass casualties. 'Build-break-iterate' fine for apps, catastrophic for AI. If you own AI infrastructure, size for an event that could crater the entire sector overnight.

excerpts.label: Liquidity rule: you're only worth what you can write a check for
excerpts.insight: PTJ's grandfather's maxim reinforced by watching Bunker Hunt go from $11B to near-bankrupt in 8 weeks. Liquidity discipline as foundational risk management principle
excerpts.pm_takeaway: STAY LIQUID. Institutional portfolios at historic illiquidity: PE at 16% of portfolios (vs 7% in 2008), RE and infra elevated. At 22x S&P PE, 10yr forward returns are negative. The illiquidity premium is now a liability. Run a liquidity audit on the book.
